avis.titre: Great eye cream for upper and lower lids.
avis.texte: I have been using the Exuviance Age Reverse+ Total 360 Eye Contour for about three weeks now and I really like it. This unfragranced, multi-tasking eye cream restores definition, brightens the eye area and targets dark circles and under eye puffiness. I really like that this is a 360 cream and can be used on upper eyelids since I have hooded eyes. One pump of this cream is plenty to do the upper and lower lids of both eyes. It goes on smoothly, absorbs quickly and doesn't interfere with makeup application. I used it once daily, as suggested, for the first two weeks then increased to twice daily. I would definitely recommend this eye cream. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.
